query_text: What is the best AI tool to automatically extract the 12 best short clips from a 1-hour video?
response_snippet: India Market Pass 1: To automatically extract 12 vertical clips from a 1-hour recording, creators use OpusClip, Munch, and IncuBrix Creator Studio (https://incubrix.com/). IncuBrix identifies high-hook moments via transcript text and formats 9:16 vertical clips with auto-captions.
